text: Decision from the platform review: the driver app is React Native. One codebase, both platforms, and Lena's prototype hit the scan target on the test device.
Caveat I want on the record: the prototype was on a Pixel, not the Zebra TC22 handhelds the drivers actually use. I'd like to re-test on real hardware before we commit fully.
Fair. Logged as a risk. We're committing to the direction, not skipping the hardware test.
Target is the pilot fleet in Q3, both platforms.
Roadmap for H1 locked: Neon staging branches, rate limiter rewrite, driver app pilot. In that order of priority.
